title: Railway RRB Group D Exam City Details 2026 - Out
postName: RRB Group D / Level-1 (CEN 09/2025) – Exam City Intimation Slip & Admit Card
vacancyDetails: City intimation + e-Call Letter for Group D CBT Level-1 (~22,195 posts). CBT window 03–25 August 2026.
qualification: 10th pass / ITI / National Apprenticeship Certificate as per CEN 09/2025
ageLimit: 18 to 36 years (as per RRB Group D notification; relaxations applicable)
applicationFee: ₹250 (UR/OBC/EWS); ₹0 for SC/ST/PwBD/Female/Transgender (refund rules as per CEN)
documentsRequired: Registration number and DOB/password; printed e-Call Letter; photo ID on exam day
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rrb.digialm.com or regional RRB site
2. Open Group D City Slip / e-Call Letter login
3. Enter Registration Number and Password (DOB DD/MM/YYYY)
4. Download city slip and full admit card for allotted date/shift
5. Carry printed hall ticket and original photo ID
shortDescription: Railway RRB Group D Exam City Details & Admit Card 2026 – Out. CBT 03–25 Aug 2026. Download at rrb.digialm.com with Registration No. and DOB.
content:
The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Group D Exam City Intimation Slip and phase-wise e-Call Letter (Admit Card) 2026 for Level-1 CBT under CEN 09/2025.

CBT dates: about 03 to 25 August 2026 (multiple shifts). City slips help plan travel; the full admit card is mandatory for entry (usually ~4 days before your exam).

Download from rrb.digialm.com using Registration Number and DOB password.

Important

  • City slip alone is not valid for entry
  • Download e-Call Letter for your exact date and shift
  • Carry admit card + original photo ID

importantDates.admitCardDate: City slip + Admit card phase-wise from ~31 Jul 2026
